summary.business: Technocrats Plasma Systems Limited is an engineering-led manufacturer of plasma cutting machines, welding equipment and customised automation systems for metal fabrication and related industries in India. Its products are used by customers across automotive, construction, shipbuilding, heavy engineering and general manufacturing sectors, and its activities span system configuration, detailed engineering, fabrication, assembly, testing, installation/commissioning support and after-sales service and spares.
